subject: physics

hotspots.label: Rock Pile
hotspots.description: The matter whose mass you measure — a pile of five grey rocks on the balance pan.
hotspots.positionHint: A heap of rocks on the left pan.
hotspots.function: Carries the matter being measured for its mass.

hotspots.label: Balance Scale
hotspots.description: The beam tips until both pans hold the same amount of matter — that's how it measures mass.
hotspots.function: Compares amounts of matter to read mass fairly.

hotspots.label: Standard Kilograms
hotspots.description: Standard 1 kg masses used to balance the rock pile — their total is the rock mass.
hotspots.positionHint: Stacked labelled kilogram cubes on the right pan.
hotspots.function: Provides known masses to compare against.

hotspots.label: kg Readout
hotspots.description: The mass plate that stays at the same kg number on Earth and on the Moon.
hotspots.positionHint: A floating plaque above the balance.
hotspots.function: Displays the mass in kilograms, location-independent.

hotspots.label: Location Switch
hotspots.description: Drag Earth→Moon to move the whole scene; the kg readout never changes.
hotspots.positionHint: A slider with Earth and Moon icons on a post.
hotspots.function: Toggles location to test mass invariance.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. Wooden balance scale with grey rocks and green labelled kg cubes, a floating coral readout plaque, and a small Earth/Moon slider. Saturated color only on readout and switch. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0. Beam/stand: warm oak (roughness ~0.55). Pans: brass-look but matte warm (roughness ~0.5). Rocks: grey-warm (roughness ~0.75). Kg cubes: matte green with ink '1 kg' faces. Readout: paper with ink digits.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: mass as amount of matter measured by a balance, invariant across locations.

GEOMETRY: balance scale centered (fulcrum at 0,0.55,0, beam length ~2.2, pans at ±0.55,0.3). Left pan holds a small rock pile; right pan holds removable 1 kg cubes. Plaque floats (0,1.4,0.4). Location slider post at (1.2,0.5,0) with two world backdrops switched by the app.

INTERACTION: kg cubes are added/removed; beam pivots until level. Location switch swaps a ground disc from 'Earth' to 'Moon' hue and shows the readout holding constant.

LAYERS: scale+rocks; kg set; location switch; readout.

NAMED NODES: BalanceBase, BalanceBeam, LeftPan, RightPan, RockPile, KgCube1/2/3, ReadoutPlate, LocationSlider. 6-10k tris.
